extras.title: Automated Detection of Visual Attribute Reliance with a Self-Reflective Agent
extras.tldr: An agent that finds which visual attributes a trained vision model secretly relies on, by proposing hypotheses, testing them with experiments, and checking its own conclusions.

extras.title: Experimenting with Affective Computing Models in Video Interviews with Spanish-Speaking Older Adults
extras.tldr: Off-the-shelf emotion models barely agree with human labels, or with each other, on older Spanish speakers. We release a new video-interview dataset to study this gap.

extras.title: OpenMAIA: a Multimodal Automated Interpretability Agent based on open-source models
extras.tldr: MAIA-style automated interpretability, where an agent designs experiments to explain what neurons do, rebuilt entirely on open-source models.
